title: -GT930 Track Grey

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The Scorpion EXO GT930 Track Grey is designed for versatile commuters and touring riders requiring multi-mode adaptability, delivering flip-up versatility for city stops and sealed protection at speed. Built around a High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) shell weighing 1603g, its multi-density EPS matrix is aerodynamically sculpted to isolate cabin noise to ~88 dB while dissipating kinetic impact forces across DOT, ECE 22.06 benchmarks. Inside, 3D laser-cut cheek pads tailor naturally to an Intermediate Oval profile with dedicated eyewear relief channels, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for confident all-day riding.

product_details.description: Transformer modular with optional chin-guard removal for open-face mode.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Modular chin bar; fits most head shapes but may feel tight for users with larger occipital lobes due to track-specific shell geometry.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Scorpion EXO -GT930 Track Grey: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.

introduction: Positioned in Scorpion EXO's Modular lineup, the -GT930 Track Grey brings Global Premium engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.06 track safety.
story:
The Scorpion EXO GT930 Track Grey represents Scorpion EXO's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~88 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) Modular helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Scorpion EXO GT930 Track Grey delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
